ask.label: Your question
ask.placeholder: Ask about a place, in French, Arabic or English
ask.noLocation: Click the map to choose a place, or name it in the question.
ask.intro: Point at a place and ask: the agent picks a NISAR recipe, computes, cross-checks with independent evidence and says what it cannot know.

steps.title: Agent steps
steps.fromCache: Offline: answer replayed from the local cache.

answer.label: Answer
answer.stableNote: No motion exceeds the measurement noise. That is an answer, not a missing one.
answer.noSeries: No time series for this recipe.
answer.noEvidence: No independent evidence available for this place.
answer.limits: What the radar cannot tell here
answer.watchPreview: Message sent whenever the level changes
answer.notFound: This answer does not exist or is no longer available.

desc.high: Signal well above noise, good coherence, independent evidence agrees.
desc.medium: Signal above noise, without independent evidence or with partial coherence.
desc.low: Signal close to noise, or heavily masked area.

desc.yellow: Change detected, low confidence: keep watching.
desc.orange: Change or acceleration, medium or high confidence.
desc.red: High confidence, people or buildings exposed.

map.label: Radar measurement map
map.noWebgl: The map needs WebGL. Measurements remain readable in the panel.

discover.title: What NISAR found in {{region}}
discover.subtitle: Areas moving faster than {{factor}} times the noise ({{noise}}), {{start}} to {{end}}.
discover.empty: No area exceeds {{factor}} times the noise over the period: the ground is stable within noise wherever NISAR looked.
discover.ruler: Velocity and uncertainty against the noise threshold

watch.title: Watch
watch.intro: On every new NISAR pass over a watched place, the analysis is rerun and you are notified if the level changes.
watch.empty: No watched place. From an answer, choose “Watch this place”.
watch.overdue: pass expected, data not yet published
watch.notificationsEmpty: No notification: the level has not changed since the watch started.
watch.bilingual: Notification sent in French and Arabic

library.title: World library
library.intro: Analysed and verified events, each compared with an independent source.
library.empty: The library is empty for now.

proof.title: L-band versus C-band
proof.intro: Same slopes, same dates: where Sentinel-1 loses coherence under forest, NISAR still measures.

tpl.verdict.sudden_motion: The ground moved up to {{max}} along the line of sight between the passes bracketing {{date}}.
tpl.verdict.slow_motion.moving: The site is moving at {{velocity}}. Motion is likely; an inspection will confirm it.
tpl.verdict.slow_motion.accelerating: The slope is moving at {{velocity}} and has been accelerating since {{since}}. Motion is likely; an inspection will confirm it.
tpl.verdict.stable_in_noise: Nothing measurable beyond the noise ({{noise}}) since {{since}}. We keep watching.
tpl.verdict.soil_moisture: Soils are very wet: {{value}}, which is {{anomaly}} above previous passes.
tpl.verdict.lband_proof: On the most forested slopes, Sentinel-1 drops below the usable coherence threshold ({{threshold}}); NISAR stays above it.
tpl.step.cache: Precomputed answer found in the atlas
tpl.step.compute.decompose: Ascending and descending tracks combined into vertical and east-west
tpl.step.verdict: Verdict written from a fixed template, numbers from the computation
tpl.check.noise_floor: Spread measured over a stable reference area: {{noise}}.
tpl.check.coherence_mask: {{fraction}} of pixels fall below the coherence threshold ({{threshold}}) and are masked.
tpl.check.ionosphere.applied: Ionospheric correction shipped with the product applied.
tpl.check.ionosphere.missing: No ionospheric correction layer for this scene: area flagged.
tpl.check.unwrapping.ok: No phase jump detected between connected components.
tpl.check.unwrapping.jumps_one: {{count}} isolated connected component excluded from the computation.
tpl.check.unwrapping.jumps_other: {{count}} isolated connected components excluded from the computation.
tpl.evidence.usgs.mainshock_one: M{{mag}} earthquake on {{date}} and {{count}} aftershock in the area.
tpl.evidence.usgs.mainshock_other: M{{mag}} earthquake on {{date}} and {{count}} aftershocks in the area.
tpl.evidence.usgs.none: No catalogued earthquake within {{radius}} km over the period.
tpl.evidence.open_meteo.rain: {{rain}} of accumulated rain over the {{days}} days before the last pass.
tpl.evidence.osm.exposure: {{buildings}} buildings and {{roads}} km of roads in the footprint.
tpl.evidence.nasa.map: The displacement map published by NASA for this sequence agrees.
tpl.limit.los_only: A single viewing geometry: vertical and east-west motion are not separated.
tpl.limit.north_south: North-south motion is nearly invisible to a polar-orbiting radar.
tpl.limit.decorrelation: Where the ground was too disrupted, coherence is lost and no displacement is measured.
tpl.limit.no_prediction: The radar tells what moved and by how much, not what will happen.
tpl.limit.dam_structure: The radar measures the dam surface, not its internal state, leaks or pressures.
tpl.limit.short_history: Calibrated products start on {{since}}: a seasonal cycle cannot yet be separated from a trend.
tpl.limit.soil_depth: SME2 describes the top few centimetres of soil, not groundwater or deep saturation.
tpl.limit.resolution: Plots smaller than {{resolution}} m are not resolved.
tpl.limit.proof_single_pair: A single date pair is compared: the gap may vary with season and moisture.
tpl.limit.proof_baseline: The two satellites have neither the same geometry nor exactly the same interval between passes.
tpl.indication.caveat: Inverse-velocity method (Fukuzono), with one point every {{revisit}} days. This is not a forecast: the window may shift or vanish at the next pass.
tpl.notify.watch_created: Watch active on {{place}}. Next NISAR pass on {{next_pass}}: you will be notified if the level changes.
tpl.library.nasa_map: NASA displacement map of the same sequence.
tpl.error.no_fixture: The test data holds no answer to this question. Try one of the demo questions.
tpl.error.no_coverage: No NISAR scene covers this place over the requested period.
